Where two documents define the same term differently, the more specific document controls for that domain (e.g., 'baseline' in assessment reports vs. enrollment data policy). Baseline Data Minimum enrollment fields required before a student ID is activated in SDP; NOT identical to assessment 'baseline wave' in RLOS

learning outcomes study rlos phase2 Page 19 historical distrust of digitized records—linking privacy communication to assessment uptake is therefore not merely a legal matter but a measurement issue. Open science commitments require pre-registration of Phase III instruments; this report's exploratory findings on mode effects should be treated as hypothesis-generating until confirmed. Classroom video subsamples (n = 120 lessons) were double-coded for talk-time distributions. Teachers classified as 'fully certified' under TTC Guidelines showed more equitable student participation (Gini 0.41 vs. 0.52, p < 0.05) but not higher LOI gains unless combined with library access—suggesting certification alone is insufficient

student data privacy policy 2024 Page 2 6.2.1 Clickstream and session logs from DLI may be processed for instructional improvement without parental consent if anonymized at aggregation; student-level logs require notice per Article 8. Article 7 — Retention 7.2 Research tokens linked to RLOS samples: retention 10 years, then secure deletion. 7.4 Alumni records: retention until age 25 or 7 years post-exit, whichever later. Article 9 — Research Exceptions 9.3 NIEA studies may receive pseudonymized extracts under MoU; re-identification prohibited (penalties Article 12). Cross-reference NIEA/TR/2024/LO-02 Annexure D
student data privacy policy 2024 Page 25 Board Phase Deadline SEB-MH Phase 1 Due 2024-Q3 SEB-MH Phase 1 Due 2024-Q4
